title: HtmlUl
responsibility: Renders the native ul element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlUl.attributes
inputs.description: Native ul attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: HtmlUl.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native ul element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: HtmlUl
outputs.description: The actual native ul element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
